quest.title: Of Drink A-Dreaming
quest.description: Angel's Share seems to have started hosting some special event recently...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Okay, we'll give it a shot.

dialogues.speaker: Luka
dialogues.text: Great, then please come on in. First, Charles will walk you through some basic techniques.

talks.objective: Talk to Luka and enter the tavern

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: Hey, I know you two. So, what can I get for you today?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hi, Charles.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, Charles! Actually, we came to be bartenders today!

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: Bartenders? Oh, so Luka roped you two in, did he? He's got quite a knack for that.

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, you're certainly talented at handling difficult tasks, there's no doubt about that. But mixing cocktails is a whole different game, it's delicate work and requires a certain amount of finesse.

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: Everything from the ratios of your ingredients to your mixing techniques could affect the final product.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Don't worry. {F#She's}{M#He's} a fantastic cook. Cooking and cocktail-making have a lot in common, you know!

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: Alright, I'll take your word for it. Oh, and one more thing...

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: In a previous event, we had a student who arbitrarily mixed three kinds of hard liquor. Just one glass was enough to leave a customer passed out on the floor.

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: So in light of that incident, we decided to no longer provide alcoholic ingredients to beginners. I hope you'll understand.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: No problem at all.

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: Great, that just about covers all I have to say. You'll learn all the skills and techniques you need on the fly.

talks.objective: Learn how to make the specified drinks

dialogues.speaker: Luka
dialogues.text: So, what do you think? Will you give the academy a try?

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: Mmm, you're a quick learner, this tastes pretty good.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon agrees! This is amazing!

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: That was just practice, though. On the job, customers often will have special requests for their drinks.

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: Some may enjoy a stiffer drink, while others might prefer something more sour, everyone has their own preferences. Adjusting the amounts of the ingredients is always the key.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon would like a Caramel Pinecone, extra sweet, in the biggest glass you have. Please and thank you!

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: Well, that's about all there is to it. But, to become a truly exceptional bartender, in addition to mixing skills, you'll also need to master conversing with your customers...

response.speaker: Charles
response.text: Alright, in that case, you two can take this counter. If you have questions or need any help, just give me a holler.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whew... Class dismissed! Wait, where's Paimon's Caramel Pinecone?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So you really did want a Caramel Pinecone...

dialogues.speaker: Luka
dialogues.text: Hello there! So, you must be the renowned Traveler.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, don't forget about the equally renowned Paimon!

response.speaker: Luka
response.text: Hehe, of course. Well, it just so happens that our tavern, Angel's Share, is hosting a Bartender's Academy Week. I'm hoping the event might interest you.

response.speaker: Luka
response.text: Basically, you'll have full access to all of our ingredients to mix cocktails or any other drink you please.

response.speaker: Luka
response.text: As long as you refrain from being wasteful, you can enjoy unlimited refills for the drinks you create.

response.speaker: Luka
response.text: Also, you'll be rewarded handsomely if the guests are happy with your drinks.

response.speaker: Luka
response.text: It's called an "academy" but attendance is certainly not mandatory...

response.speaker: Luka
response.text: And you don't have to make your decision right away. You're more than welcome to give it a try first.

response.speaker: Luka
response.text: So, what do you think? Will you give the academy a try?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We need some time to consider.

dialogues.speaker: Luka
dialogues.text: Sure, no problem. Please come back whenever you're ready.
